articles.title: Deadly shooting near Paris is a 'racist terrorist attack', Macron says
articles.description: One person is killed and five wounded in a series of attacks. The suspected gunman has been apprehended.

articles.title: Seven shot dead by gunmen at church funeral in Jordan, officials say
articles.description: Thirty-four people are also injured in the attack in southern Karak governorate, and a manhunt is now under way.

articles.title: Freed US citizen was tortured in Russian jail, former Ukrainian prisoners say
articles.description: Ukrainians held alongside the American say they witnessed beatings and sexual humiliation by Russian guards during his detention.

articles.title: Israeli forces begin demolishing Palestinian buildings in Hebron after two Israeli soldiers shot dead
articles.description: The soldiers were killed in an attack by two Palestinian gunmen at a checkpoint outside the West Bank city on Friday morning.

articles.title: White House says Melania Trump brokered truce for Ukraine city 'on brink of disaster'
articles.description: Ukraine and Russia confirm the truce in Russian-occupied Oleshky, where residents have had to eat garden weeds to survive.

articles.title: Argentina drops investigation into President Milei over crypto fraud
articles.description: Javier Milei had denied acting fraudulently when a cryptocurrency nosedived after he deleted a social media post about it.

articles.title: Oil spill washes up on UAE beaches after tanker strike
articles.description: Satellite images show oil spreading for miles along the coastline, threatening local marine wildlife

articles.title: Ukraine says Starlink still restricted after Trump says limits lifted
articles.description: The network is used by the Ukrainian military, sources say, and Trump says "if there is a problem, I'll get it straightened out".

articles.title: Denmark to ban mink farming in government U-turn
articles.description: Once the world's largest producer of mink pelts, the nation's industry has declined in recent years.

articles.title: PSG v Lyon moved as Paris prepares for more protests
articles.description: Paris St-Germain's Ligue 1 match against Lyon at the Parc des Princes is pushed back 24 hours as the French capital prepares for another weekend of protests.

articles.title: Cyprus police open investigation into financial affairs of Roman Abramovich
articles.description: Questions about the integrity of some of Abramovich's professional advisers, were raised earlier this month.

articles.title: Woman with Ebola in Nigeria confirmed as wife of Swiss diplomat
articles.description: Her husband is currently in isolation but has not developed any symptoms,  Swiss officials say.

articles.title: Watch: CCTV footage shows gunmen near church in Jordan
articles.description: Dozens of people had been inside the church for a funeral when the shooting began, local media report.

articles.title: Doctors tell the BBC about the targeting of Sudanese hospitals by paramilitary fighters
articles.description: A BBC investigation has found evidence that Sudanese paramilitary fighters systematically destroyed el-Fasher's healthcare system.

articles.title: Blue Planet III: Moment octopus escapes death after hunt gone wrong
articles.description: The sequence is part of the latest Blue Planet series from Sir David Attenborough.

articles.title: 'It's part of the culture' - New York bans horse-drawn carriages after more than 160 years
articles.description: The BBC's Madeline Halpert spoke to city tourists, residents and horse carriage workers about the industry and their opinion on the ban.

articles.title: Damaging hail pelts Phoenix in rare storm
articles.description: Videos from the Arizona capital show people sheltering inside a car as hail smashes the windscreen, while intense downpours covered neighbourhoods in ice.

articles.title: Hispanic voters helped bring Trump to power - in Texas, the tide may be turning
articles.description: Recent polls suggest the president is facing challenging headwinds in the state ahead of the midterms.

articles.title: Rubio turns to small Indian town as US faces high oil prices
articles.description: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio pushed a business and energy agenda over diplomacy on his second trip to India this year.

articles.title: Attack on actor Tiger Shroff is dark reminder of Bollywood's gangster past
articles.description: The attack on Shroff has revived memories of the 1990s, when gangsters wielded influence over the industry.

articles.title: Surveillance and 'constant paranoia': Western diplomats tell BBC of life in war-time Moscow
articles.description: Officials compare working in Russia since its full-scale invasion of Ukraine to the Cold War era.
